title: The AI Productivity Paradox: Why 10X Output Doesn't Mean 10X Business Outcome - Mik Kersten
summary: Mik Kersten argues AI makes software output abundant, so the constraint moves to feedback, planning and outcomes, and warns against layoffs justified by output gains.

verdicts.note: This controlled crossover experiment did validate a large productivity gain (completeness +43 points, robust to session checks), so gains have been shown in controlled studies. But the setting was 75-minute toy tasks, mostly students, and no time gain held up, which says nothing about headcount-level gains.
